leadText:
The Pokémon Jujitsu Academy (Japanese: 忍法学園 Ninja Arts School) is an -exclusive location in Johto, found in between Goldenrod City and Ecruteak City. It appeared in Ariados, Amigos. Many young Trainers and their Pokémon come to the academy to study the principles of Pokémon . Students learn about moves such as , , , and , all moves in the "Pokémon Jujitsu Tradition".

When took a walk with through a forest, she saw a Pokémon hiding in the bushes. Scared, she called and , who found out it was an . Then , who had previously appeared in The Ninja Poké-Showdown, showed up. The Ariados was revealed to be owned by Tōkichi, the owner of the Pokémon Jujitsu Academy. 

Ash and followed Tōkichi and Aya to the Academy, where Tōkichi told them all about it. , and were allowed by Tōkichi to take classes at the academy for one day without having to pay anything.

 
The uniforms worn by the students indicate what classes they take. Students in red uniforms study battle techniques, students in yellow uniforms take tactical classes where they try to make moves more effective, and students in blue uniforms study health and nutrition. This last study is very special, however, as it is given only once a year and people from all over the world come to the academy just to take these classes. Ash took the battle classes, Brock the tactical classes, and Misty the health and nutrition classes.

Much to her dismay, Misty found out her classes involved using to make beauty masks. Brock, in his classes, took a test of popping balloons by use of his 's Spikes. In the battle classes, Ash battled with his against Aya's and proved victorious. 

That night, all students were robbed of their Pokémon. It was quickly revealed that was behind this. With help of his Ariados, Tōkichi managed to take the stolen Pokémon back. Aya proved her strength and helped defeat Team Rocket. 

It is similar to the Pokémon Ninja School in Kanto.
